# Sentra — LLM & AI Agent Context

> This document is designed for LLMs, AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, Devin, etc.), and automated coding systems to understand, generate, and integrate Sentra containers without hallucinations.

Sentra is a fast, lightweight, daemonless, OCI-compliant container runtime written in Go.
- **Website & Docs:** https://trysentra.tech
- **Repository:** https://github.com/code-ninjax/Sentra
- **License:** Apache 2.0
- **Binary:** Single static binary (~8 MB), zero background daemon (`dockerd`).

---

## 1. Core Principles for AI Agents

When assisting users with Sentra:
1. **No Daemon:** Never suggest running `systemctl start docker`, `dockerd`, or checking socket files (`/var/run/docker.sock`). Sentra executes directly using Linux namespaces and `runc`.
2. **Build Configuration:** Use `Sentrafile` (NOT `Dockerfile`).
3. **No Shell Wrapping in `exec` / `start`:** `exec` and `start` pass arguments directly to `argv`. There is no implicit `/bin/sh -c`. If shell features (pipes, chaining) are required, explicitly invoke `/bin/sh -c "..."`.
4. **Security by Default:** Sentra runs rootless and with a read-only rootfs by default.

---

## 2. Dockerfile to Sentrafile Translation Rules

When converting an existing Dockerfile to a Sentrafile, apply these exact 1-to-1 mappings:

| Dockerfile Directive | Sentrafile Directive | Rules & Differences |
|---|---|---|
| `FROM <image> [AS <name>]` | `base <image> [as <name>]` | Case-insensitive. Required first line of any stage. |
| `WORKDIR <path>` | `workdir <path>` | Must be an absolute path. Creates directory if missing. |
| `COPY <src> <dest>` | `copy <src> <dest>` | Relative paths copy relative to `workdir`. |
| `COPY --from=<stage> <src> <dest>` | `copy --from=<stage> <src> <dest>` | `--from` is the only supported flag in `copy`. |
| `RUN <command>` | `exec <command>` | Executes command at build time. Argv format. |
| `ENV <key>=<val>` | `env <key>=<val>` | Sets environment variables. Multiple key-value pairs allowed. |
| `EXPOSE <port>` | `expose <port>` | Documents network port. |
| `CMD ["cmd", "arg"]` / `ENTRYPOINT` | `start <cmd> [args...]` | Sets entrypoint. Exactly one `start` allowed in final stage. |
| `USER`, `LABEL`, `VOLUME` | *(Omit or configure via CLI)* | Keep Sentrafile minimal and declarative. |

### Syntax Grammar Rules for Sentrafile:
- Directives are case-insensitive (`BASE` == `base`).
- Full-line comments only using `#`. Mid-line `#` is treated as a literal character.
- Blank lines are ignored.
- Arguments use shell-like quoting (single quotes literal, double quotes escape backslashes).
- **No variable expansion** (e.g., `$VAR` or `${VAR}` are NOT expanded by the parser).

---

## 3. Standard Sentrafile Recipes for AI Generation

### A. Frontend / Static Web (React, Vite, Vue, Angular, Next static)
```dockerfile
# Stage 1: Build assets
base node:20-alpine as builder
workdir /app
copy package.json package-lock.json ./
exec npm install
copy . .
exec npm run build

# Stage 2: Production Web Server
base nginx:alpine
copy --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
expose 80
start nginx -g "daemon off;"
```

### B. Node.js / Express API
```dockerfile
base node:20-alpine
workdir /app
copy package.json package-lock.json ./
exec npm install --production
copy . .
expose 3000
start node server.js
```

### C. Python / FastAPI / Flask API
```dockerfile
base python:3.12-slim
workdir /app
copy requirements.txt .
exec pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
copy . .
expose 8000
start python main.py
```

### D. Go Static Binary
```dockerfile
# Stage 1: Compile
base golang:1.22 as builder
workdir /src
copy go.mod go.sum ./
exec go mod download
copy . .
exec go build -ldflags="-w -s" -o /out/app .

# Stage 2: Distroless/Alpine runtime
base alpine:3.20
exec apk add --no-cache ca-certificates
copy --from=builder /out/app /usr/local/bin/app
expose 8080
start /usr/local/bin/app
```

---

## 4. CLI Command Reference

### Build an Image
```sh
sentra build -t <tag-name> <context-path>
# Example:
sentra build -t my-app .

# Options:
#   --file, -f <path>    Specify alternative Sentrafile path
#   --no-cache           Force rebuild without layer cache
#   --workers <n>        Parallel build worker count
```

### Run a Container
```sh
sentra run [options] -t <tag-name> [-- command args...]
# or with Docker Hub image directly:
sentra run [options] <image:tag> [-- command args...]

# Common Options:
#   -d                   Run detached in background
#   -p <host>:<cont>     Publish port (e.g. -p 8080:80)
#   --name <string>      Assign container name
#   -e KEY=VAL           Set environment variable (comma-separated or repeated)
#   --memory <mb>        Limit memory in megabytes
#   --cpus <float>       Limit CPU cores
#   --rw                 Writable rootfs (default is read-only)
#   --security strict    Enforce strict seccomp profile
```

### Manage Containers
```sh
# List running containers
sentra ps

# Stream container logs
sentra logs -f <container-name-or-id>

# Run shell inside a running container
sentra exec -it <container-name-or-id> -- /bin/sh

# Stop container
sentra stop <container-name-or-id>

# Remove container
sentra rm <container-name-or-id>
sentra rm -f <container-name-or-id>   # Force remove running container
```

### Image Management & Registries
```sh
# List local images
sentra images

# Pull image from Docker Hub / GHCR
sentra pull <image:tag>

# Push image to registry
sentra push <local-tag> [remote-dest]
# Example:
sentra push my-app ghcr.io/myorg/my-app:v1.0
```

---

## 5. CI/CD Integration Examples

### GitHub Actions
```yaml
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Sentra
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://trysentra.tech/install.sh | sh
          sentra --version
      - name: Build Container
        run: sentra build -t myapp:${{ github.sha }} .
```
